meta.note: Copy of the current website design file. Colour and type values are the file's own variables; other values were read from layers and are marked in usage.

tokens.name: primary-navy
tokens.usage: Figma UI/Primary/Navy. Headings, dark sections (stats strip, testimonial cards, footer), selected tags. White text on it: 17.4:1.

tokens.name: primary-pink
tokens.usage: Figma UI/Primary/Pink. The one accent: button fill and border, text links, active tab underline, value icons. 4.17:1 on white: fails AA for normal-size text, passes for large text and UI borders. See README, Contrast.

tokens.name: primary-white
tokens.usage: Figma UI/Primary/White. Page background, button labels, text on navy.

tokens.name: complementary-text
tokens.usage: Figma UI/Complementary/Text. Body copy and nav labels on white and on the pale tints (9.7:1 on white).

tokens.name: complementary-purple
tokens.usage: Figma UI/Complementary/Purple. On navy only: footer headings, testimonial names, the + in stats (6.1:1). Fails as text on white (2.8:1); decorative there (frame lines, tag outlines, wave lines).

tokens.name: complementary-orange
tokens.usage: Figma UI/Complementary/Orange. Defined in the file, rarely used on screen. Fails as text on white (3.1:1). Treat as decorative or on navy only (5.6:1).

tokens.name: complementary-light-blue
tokens.usage: Figma UI/Complementary/Light_blue. Pale section background (hero, contact band). Body and heading colours keep AA on it.

tokens.name: complementary-light-pink
tokens.usage: Figma UI/Complementary/Light_pink. Pale section background (case study panels, the contact page side card).

tokens.name: tint-peach
tokens.usage: Read from the second case study panel on Home (layer 1:1022). Not a named variable in the file. Pale section background, used alternately with complementary-light-pink.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Navy at 15%, read from the tag and input layers (not a named variable in the file). 2px borders on inputs, unselected tags, dividers.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: The fill of the black logo as drawn in the file (near-black, not navy). Use only inside the logo file; never as a UI colour.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Navy at 15% as a 2px line: inactive tab underline, process step connector.

tokens.name: on-navy-border
tokens.usage: White at 40%: input border on navy (footer newsletter field).

tokens.name: on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: White at 80%: footer links and secondary text on navy.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Let's talk about your technology needs
styles.usage: Figma UI/Display xl/Desktop. Page H1 in the hero, stat numbers in the navy strip.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Figma UI/Display md/Desktop. Case study and sub-section headings.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Figma UI/Display sm/Desktop. Card titles, job titles, footer column headings (purple on navy), process step titles.

styles.name: display-xs
styles.usage: Figma UI/Display xs/Desktop. Form section labels, small headings.

styles.name: button-big
styles.usage: Figma UI/Button/Big. Always uppercase. Big buttons, text links.

styles.name: button-small
styles.usage: Figma UI/Button/Small. Always uppercase. Small buttons, header navigation, text links.

styles.name: text-lg-regular
styles.sample: A team of software engineers ready to join yours.
styles.usage: Figma UI/Text lg/Desktop/Regular. Hero intro paragraph.

styles.name: text-lg-bold
styles.usage: Figma UI/Text lg/Desktop/Bold. Emphasis inside the hero intro.

styles.name: text-md-regular
styles.sample: Schedule a call and tell us about your system.
styles.usage: Figma UI/Text md/Desktop/Regular. Default body text.

styles.name: text-md-bold
styles.usage: Figma UI/Text md/Desktop/Bold. Value labels, inline emphasis.

styles.name: text-md-italic
styles.usage: Figma UI/Text md/Desktop/Italic. Testimonial quotes only.

styles.name: text-sm-regular
styles.usage: Figma UI/Text sm/Desktop/Regular. Card descriptions, tags, inputs, footer links.

styles.name: text-sm-medium
styles.usage: Figma UI/Text sm/Desktop/Medium. Selected tag label.

styles.name: text-sm-bold-uppercase
styles.usage: Figma UI/Text sm/Desktop/Bold uppercase. Set in uppercase. Eyebrows above case study titles, author names.

styles.name: text-xs-regular
styles.sample: I agree to receive marketing communications
styles.usage: Figma UI/Text xs/Regular. Consent text, legal lines. Smallest size in the system.

tokens.name: space-tag-y
tokens.usage: Tag padding, top and bottom (tag layer 1:3512).

tokens.name: space-btn-small-y
tokens.usage: Small button padding, top and bottom (1:3930). Also the gap between an input's icon and text.

tokens.name: space-input-y
tokens.usage: Input padding, top and bottom (1:1953).

tokens.name: space-tag-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between tags in a filter row.

tokens.name: space-inset
tokens.usage: Tag and input side padding. Also the mobile page gutter (375px frames).

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Blog card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-btn-small-x
tokens.usage: Small button side padding.

tokens.name: space-quote-x
tokens.usage: Testimonial card side padding; also the gap inside it.

tokens.name: space-quote-y
tokens.usage: Testimonial card top and bottom padding; tab side padding.

tokens.name: space-job
tokens.usage: Job card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-btn-big-x
tokens.usage: Big button side padding (top and bottom 13.5px).

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between Home page sections, and the desktop side gutter (1200px content in a 1440px frame).

tokens.name: space-offset
tokens.usage: How far the signature outline sits behind buttons and slider arrows, right and down.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every button, tag, input and card in the file has square corners. There is no rounded radius in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Figma effect style Shadow. Blog cards, job cards, the author chip on blog cards.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: Blog card and its author chip (layer 1:914).

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: The single stroke weight: buttons, the offset outline, tags, inputs.

tokens.name: frame-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop frame width in the file.

tokens.name: content-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop content column.

tokens.name: frame-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile frame width in the file.

tokens.name: header-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop header height. Logo 144x36 at the left gutter.

tokens.name: header-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile header height.
